findings.text: the tail check runs even when the mask is already lattice-length, where discarded.size is 0 and _non_lattice_rows returns the wall row count, so a legitimate prefix mask handed a state-wide state now raises; scripts/prototypes/promoted_nodes_near_xpoint/measure_promoted_nodes.py:296 passes exactly that shape and worked at the base revision.
the only test carrying the repaired promoted-count, polished-saddle-distance and saddle-offset assertions timed out at 3300 s in both arms, so the node's headline repair has no recorded green state.

_non_lattice_rows falls back to state_size - node_count when the operator's wall exposes no null coordinate, making the refusal a tautology on that path and silently restoring the unguarded truncation.
the fragment states that a mask ordered differently is refused, but the guard compares only the tail's length, so a same-length mask ordered differently is accepted.

the head arm's first line names revision bea2717c5 while line 2 admits the measured tree was uncommitted and the launch-time rev-parse read 70d362432, so the log's revision is reconstructed rather than read.
